free_tier.stated: free plan max_byte_size 26,214,400 (25 MiB); paid 'purple'/'onyx' 104,857,600 (100 MiB). `file_expiration: [0,0]` on every plan = never expires.

egress.terms: unmetered, Cloudflare-fronted (Server: cloudflare, Cache-Control public max-age=14400).

interface_detail: NIP-96 HTTP file storage. Discoverable at /.well-known/nostr/nip96.json; POST /upload; /presigned 'handles up to 5 GB'.
tooling: curl; NIP-98 Authorization header (signed event). The llms.txt documents the /presigned path for large objects.
chaining: machine-readable plan manifest means the cap is queryable rather than scraped — one GET tells you the size ceiling per plan.
limits_note: per-object-cap 25 MiB free. 125 MB on the direct /upload, 5 GB via /presigned (per llms.txt) — the /presigned path is the one that matters and it is far above the free plan's advertised 25 MiB.
reliability_note: transforms media at ingest on some paths (resizing, format_conversion, compression, metadata_stripping are all listed in the manifest) — verify originals come back byte-identical, per BRIEF rule 4.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: literal body: api_url https://nostrmedia.com/upload, download_url https://file.nostrmedia.com, supported_nips [94,96,98], plans.free.max_byte_size 26214400, file_expiration [0,0], media_transformations image [resizing, format_conversion, compression, metadata_stripping]
'A single POST to /upload accepts files up to 125 MB; /presigned handles up to 5 GB', 'Uploads never expire while the subscription is active'

extras.unit_note: free_tier.unit is 'mixed' because the headline is denominated in MiB or KiB, which the schema enum does not carry; the verbatim free_tier.stated keeps the true unit. See the storage-dossier handover.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
